findings.fix: Add the missing parallel forms next to `tracePart_quarkPart` (line 102) and `tracePart_quarkPart_of_diracEq` (line 110): `tracelessPart_quarkPart (hg : g.IsSymm) (hγ : ∀ μ, (β * γ μ).IsHermitian) (ψ) (Dψ) : tracelessPart g (quarkPart β γ ψ Dψ) = quarkPart β γ ψ Dψ - ((star ψ ⬝ᵥ β *ᵥ diracOpApply g γ Dψ).re / Fintype.card n) • g`, proved by `rw [tracelessPart_apply, tracePart_quarkPart hg hγ]`, and the on-shell variant from `tracePart_quarkPart_of_diracEq`; list them in the Main statements block.
findings.issue: The file develops both projections for the gluon part (`tracePart_gluonPart`, `tracelessPart_gluonPart_eq_self`) and for the total (`tracePart_total*`, `tracelessPart_total*`), but for the quark part only `tracePart_quarkPart` / `tracePart_quarkPart_of_diracEq`. `tracelessPart_total_of_trace_gluonPart_eq_zero` and `tracelessPart_total_of_card_eq_four` therefore end in an unevaluated `tracelessPart g (quarkPart β γ ψ Dψ)` — the quark twist-two operator the module docstring (lines 17-18) and the roadmap (Layer 2 `H_q`, Layer 4 mixing) name — with no lemma giving it; a consumer must unfold through `Matrix.tracelessPart_apply`.

summary: The MetricTrace surface is complete and well-annotated (apply/def forms as `(rfl)`, idempotence and orthogonality at both pointwise and composition level, kernel/range iffs, symmetry and equivariance), and the ColorDecomposition rebase leaves no compatibility residue. The one gap is on the QCD side: the quark half of the trace/traceless pairing has no traceless-part lemma, so the headline `tracelessPart_total_*` statements leave their quark summand uncomputable without unfolding.
